cohort: Fixed21 records,7 participants,88 test onsets; excluded8 never included
input: Causal robust amplitude A, divided by positive fitting-prefix median; 20Hz samples. RA input supplementary.
EWS: Trailing linear-detrended5T windows;3T,7T and RA5T sensitivity. AC1=sum lag products/sum squares. Variance ddof1. AR1 phi=sum lag products/sum squared predictors. kappa=-log(phi)/0.05 ONLY0<phi<1. Invalid kappa/constant statistics abstain (candidate false), not silently interpreted as recovery. Reddening=sum PSD(0<f<=0.5/T)/sum PSD(0.5/T<f<=2/T),Hann periodogram.
thresholds: Per-record quantiles of finite EWS scores in first52% fitting prefix after full window; global quantile selected on validation; risk directions fixed (AC,var,SR up; kappa down). Existing trajectory thresholds use original65% prefix, incl validation; slopes unchanged. No test-based selection.
selection: For main EWS choose global q maximizing validation harmonic mean of event coverage and full-followup alarm precision; tie lower unmatched rate,lower active fraction. Operator/Persistence main q=.175 original. Budget q chosen solely on validation nearest active-time target .2,.3,.4, tie coverage.
burden: All prespecified q values plotted on test descriptively. Interpolation at test burden is descriptive, not deployable test-selected threshold. Actual test burden at validation-selected budgets reported.
rules: 3 rolling anchors enter,0.10s continuous candidate failure exits. EWS candidates use scalar thresholds (no artificial future3 or coordinate-support gate). Same evaluation anchors, unavailable tails, reference onsets and2T window for all six methods.
trend: Align causal scores to test onsets on [-4T,0);fit-median/IQR standardized;pointwise participant-cluster bootstrap and event Kendall tau;overlapping event windows reported, not independent clinical evidence.
